g.text: House Rules / LED and harness assembly
Numbered assembly guide. Dimensions in mm; this illustration is not a 1:1 fit template.
MAIN PCB FRONT / LED bodies removed to show the lead map
DS5 (53.09,2.30) · DS6 (65.79,2.30) · DS7 (78.49,2.30). Rear view mirrors left/right.
SIX-WIRE HARNESS / pin number to the same pin number
This is a net map, not a connector-face view. Cable colours are unverified and do not define signals.
Pin 1 pad (70.325,9.70); pins 2–6 continue at 1.00 mm y steps.
Pin 1 pad (5.10,2.50); pins 2–6 continue at 1.00 mm y steps.
Specify: two plain SHR-06V-S housings, 6 wires, factory crimped, 30–50 mm, continuity 1→1…6→6.
Keep positions 2/3 adjacent for USB data. Verify every conductor before connecting power; do not substitute a reverse-wired cable.
SET THE 3.0 GAP / print TWO removable spacer rails
1. Front tray aligns the faces; rails set the air gap.
3. Tack two opposite pins on each module; let joints cool.
4. Pull both rails left and remove; then finish the joints.
5. Trim leads to the intended 1.0 rear projection.
Fit status: full seven-module dry fit and physical pixel/polarity test remain pending. Printed tools are not manufacturing proof.
